Users.title: Users
Users.delete_desc: "{email}" is disabled immediately: sign-in is blocked and existing sessions stop refreshing, though an access token already issued can keep working for up to an hour. The account is permanently removed in 30 days unless restored.
Users.restore_desc: "{email}" will be able to sign in again and is removed from the deletion queue.
Users.purge_desc: This immediately and irreversibly deletes "{email}" and everything tied to their account: organization memberships and all content they created, including content inside organizations (question banks, decks and quizzes visible to other people). This cannot be undone.
Users.no_orgs: Not a member of any organization.

UserOverrides.title: User Overrides
UserOverrides.description: An active override (no expiry, or a future expiry) is the final word in both directions: a flag never cuts an enabled override, and a disabled override stays revoked even when the flag is on. Expired rows are ignored.
UserOverrides.delete_desc: Are you sure you want to delete this override? This action cannot be undone.
